neighbours.label: later terms of a number sequence generated by a rule (multiples of n, doubling, tripling, powers), peaking on the first digit or separator of a term that can be computed from the earlier ones; arbitrary number lists, consecutive years and primes stay quiet

The primes after twenty are 23, 29, 31, 37, 41 and 43.
Platforms 2, 5, 7, 9 and 14 are closed this weekend.
Chapters 4, 9, 13, 21 and 26 deal with the war.
The bus leaves at 7, 9, 12, 15 and 18 minutes past.
